{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream wool-blend coat, relaxed fit, knee-length cut, color #f5f0e6, fabric heavy woven wool with a soft hand.
Charcoal grey trousers, straight leg, full length, color #3a4045, fabric structured cotton twill.
Olive green cashmere turtleneck, slim fit, cropped length, color #5c6b4d, fabric fine gauge knit.
Dark brown leather ankle boots with a low block heel, rounded toe, mid-calf height, color #3e2f24, leather smooth grain suitable for salted cobblestones.

This outfit works perfectly for a frosty snowy morning commute because the heavy wool coat provides essential warmth against the minus ten degree temperatures while the water-resistant fabric handles snow and road salt. The straight-leg twill trousers offer durability and easy movement during your twenty-minute walk without clinging to damp conditions, ensuring comfort on uneven cobblestone surfaces. The layered textures of the chunky knit turtleneck and smooth leather create a polished yet practical neat business look that respects your requirement for no outer layers above warmer temperatures while adapting perfectly to winter weather. The dark brown boots ground the lighter tones in the coat, providing necessary traction and style for a professional start to your day."}
